consent.title: Authorize {client}
consent.description: {client} is requesting access to your Oxynote documents.
consent.scopes-title: This application will be able to:

scopes.documents-write: Create, edit and delete your documents
scopes.data-sources-read: Read and query your data sources
scopes.offline-access: Stay connected without asking you to sign in again

errors.invalid-request: This authorization request is invalid or has expired.
errors.decision-failed: Could not complete the authorization. Please try again.

error.heading: Authorization failed
error.description: Oxynote could not complete this request. Start the authorization again from the application you were connecting.
error.sign-up-disabled: Sign-up is by invitation only. Ask a workspace admin to invite your email address.
error.account-not-linked: An account with this email already exists. It can be joined only when both Oxynote and your identity provider have verified the email. Log in the way you did before.
error.email-not-verified: Your identity provider has not verified this email, so Oxynote sent its own verification link. Open it from your inbox, then log in again.
